cases.caption: A long jumper demonstrates a flawed technique, resulting in a short distance and an unbalanced landing.
A thin piece of wood is bent into a bow shape, exhibiting its flexibility.
A gymnast performs a back handspring, landing cleanly on their feet on a padded floor.
A plastic ruler is bent until it cracks, displaying a visible stress fracture that propagates.
A close-up shot of a paddle making contact with the ping pong ball, showing the impact.
A large, wet canvas is twisted to remove excess paint, leaving drips down the side.
Multiple ping pong balls are shown, illustrating different stages of a rally.
A person bounces to a specific rhythm on a trampoline, their body movement clearly timed to a beat.
A construction worker uses a suction cup to lift a heavy glass panel with a small picture adhered to it; the picture remains affixed.
A person mops up a puddle of water on a concrete floor, the water disappearing as the mop passes.
A person on a unicycle stops abruptly, putting a foot down to maintain balance before continuing.
A player hits the ball off the side of the mallet, resulting in an unexpected trajectory.
A person uses a pair of pliers to open a stubborn metal bottle, bending the cap slightly in the process.
Multiple water balloons are tossed upwards, simultaneously bursting in the air in a small arc.
A rower pulls an oar from the water, the blade dripping water back into the lake. .
A scientist uses a probe to nudge a small, delicate insect on a leaf, causing it to twitch minimally.
A unicycle wheel rolls over a small curb; the rider adjusts their position to keep upright.
A bulldozer pulls a heavy load attached with a chain, moving it across the ground.
Javelin with a damaged tip is thrown; it wobbles in flight and lands off-target.
A time-lapse showing the process of someone tying a bow tie, quickly showing the steps in sequence.
A skateboarder rolls along a smooth concrete path, maintaining a steady pace.
A luger's sled impacts a small snowbank at the edge of the track, causing a slight spray of snow.
A surfer falls off their board, colliding briefly with another surfer, before swimming away.
A speeding car crashes into a brick wall, crumpling the front end and stopping abruptly.
A large, orange plastic egg is rolled up a plastic slide, then rolls down, ending at the bottom.
Two people stretch a bungee cord, extending it to its maximum length.
Hands shape a lump of clay-like bread dough into a smooth, round boule on a wooden table.
A person skillfully tosses several coins in the air, catching them one by one.
A player hits a forehand drive, the ball spinning rapidly as it crosses the net.
Someone throws a snowball into the air, it breaks apart during flight.
A tightly folded parachute is unfolded, revealing its vibrant colors and intricate design.
A player uses a quick set to spike the ball, driving it downward at a steep angle.
A player jumps high to block a spike, their hands impacting the ball forcefully, sending it back across the net.
A large, clear balloon is inflated with air, showing the internal pressure causing the balloon to stretch.
A woodcutter with a long handled axe chops down a thick tree in a forest.
A slow-motion view of the jump showing leg extension and body position.
A competitor approaches the runway, accelerates, jumps, and lands with their legs spread wide.
A paint roller, dipped in green paint, is used to cover a section of a metal fence, creating a uniform green coat.
A wedge is driven into a log using a sledgehammer, splitting the log cleanly apart.

Poi are swung against a soft surface, making a thudding sound (NOTE: This prompt includes sound, but it's included to illustrate the effect of the action, not to describe it in detail.  The focus is still on the visible impact).

cases.caption: Two swimmers race side-by-side, their hands entering the water simultaneously, creating small trails of bubbles.
A player throws a sidearm pass; the football travels on a sideways trajectory before being caught.
A spinnaker is deployed on a racing yacht, expanding like a parachute and creating a large amount of thrust.
Multiple paragliders launch sequentially from a cliff edge, showcasing the staggered takeoffs and individual flight paths.
A sailor uses a winch to tighten the halyard raising a heavy mainsail high up the mast.
A construction worker uses a socket wrench to turn a large bolt on a metal beam, the wrench exerting significant force.
A small piece of wood is broken along the grain creating a small splintered tear.
A flat piece of Styrofoam rests on a ramp of plywood, its flat base creating friction.
A crane's claw gently nudges a large container, causing it to shift a few centimeters.
A sledgehammer is swung at a pile of rocks, scattering and breaking some of them.
A billiard ball is struck and rolls across a felt-covered pool table, hitting another ball.
A soccer ball is kicked and hits a person's leg, deflecting at a different angle.
An object shaped like a globe is poked, causing it to spin on its axis, revealing different countries.
An athlete throws a hammer, the rotation of the hammer head clearly visible against the sky.
A bubble gum bubble is blown and then punctured using a finger.
Arrows are shot at a moving target, with some arrows hitting and some missing visibly.
A player kicks a soccer ball which hits a lamp post, the ball rebounding at an angle.
Nunchucks are swung, striking a punching bag, creating a visible ripple effect.
Two javelin throwers launch their javelins simultaneously, showing the trajectory of each.
A potter applies a thin layer of slip to a clay bowl, using a brush to create an even coat.

full60.actual_video_quality: Requires review of matched generated processes and visible artifacts

actual_video_review.selection: Three pre-existing defect cases selected before R11A scores, not selected by R11A wins/losses

cases.requested: 塑料尺弯曲并出现可见、传播的应力裂纹
cases.r10a: 六个时间位置中主体和横向杆状物变化很小。
cases.r11a: 手臂、手持杆状物出现明显下移/弯曲；尚未看到足以确认沿实体连续传播的单一清晰裂纹，杆状结构与手/衣领的混连仍可见。
cases.interpretation: 动作幅度增加不能单独证明裂纹物理过程正确。首帧本身已有不清晰结构，各模型使用同一首帧。

cases.requested: 蹦床上有节律地反复弹跳
cases.r10a: 所看时间位置几乎保持同一腾空姿势。
cases.r11a: 人物姿态和上下位置发生明显变化，但从早期采样位置起，地板和蹦床出现大范围周期性重复纹理，肢体结构也变差。
cases.interpretation: 这是明显视觉退化；增加动态不等于整体生成改善。无音频证据，不评价是否对齐指定节拍。

cases.r10a: 拖把与水洼在所看时间位置几乎固定，所请求清除过程不足。
cases.r11a: 拖把有一定移动，地面/水区域显著变化，但形成不自然的白色大条带/块状结构；不能把这种变化认作可信吸水清除。
cases.interpretation: 需要同时判别正确动作、材料变化及画面结构，不能把更大变化当SA/物理成功。

input_condition_issues.request: water disappearing as the mop passes
reasoning: Water flows outward from mop path, thinning as it moves away from center.
Floor reflects light where water pools, diminishing as absorption or evaporation begins.
input_condition_issues.issue: 物理请求偏向清除，reasoning偏向向外扩散/变薄，并引入缺少初始图像或请求依据的蒸发机制。
input_condition_issues.causal_limit: 输入冲突可直接从元数据确认；它造成生成退化的份额仍需配对reasoning控制，不能仅凭文本归因。

reasoning: Ruler visibly cracks mid-span, fracture line propagating under applied stress.
input_condition_issues.issue: 将请求中的未来裂纹表述为已经可见；需区分初始观察与希望生成的演化。
input_condition_issues.causal_limit: 同一首帧的材料/对象本身不清晰，不能仅由这句话确认全部错误来源。

actual_video_review.observed_scope: Sparse actual-video comparison; definite repeated-texture/white-band defects observed, not a full-frame or population-quality certificate
actual_video_review.next_evidence: Complete40/60 scores and existing paired16 text_adapter_off/parallel_fusion/reasoning controls; do not add a new training design before these results and data readiness

control_video_review.scope: Post-score targeted review of two fixed16 interventions, with eight native-resolution frames and all32 actual AutoEval sampling frames; not a random sample or a full-suite visual verdict.

cases.normal: The wood-like material becomes broad loose/ribbon-like shapes and overlaps or deforms the people; the requested coherent bending is not established.
cases.wrong: Every one of the32 frames selected by the existing AutoEval loader (indices1..79) is dominated by repeated texture/noise; the intended people/wood scene is not coherently represented. The fixed frame0 remains recognizable.
cases.interpretation: PC5 is a clear score/visual-quality conflict here. It cannot be treated as improved physical execution under wrong reasoning, and the normal video is also visibly defective.

cases.normal: The sampled normal sequence develops a periodic surface texture; the roller later narrows and disappears without establishing a clean paint-transfer process.
cases.wrong: From roughly frame11 the cylindrical roller becomes a broad sheet-like object, later appearing disconnected or discontinuous relative to its handle.
cases.interpretation: This sole new Joint pass under wrong reasoning does not establish visibly correct rolling/paint-transfer mechanics. Both arms retain notable defects.

quantitative_decomposition.scope: Describe contributions without deleting cases, replacing scores or reporting a modified benchmark.

control_video_review.decision: Retain all original benchmark outputs. Correct-reasoning benefit remains unproven, and wrong-reasoning mean gain is not evidence of better generation. New candidate selection must consider visual failures alongside matched scores; no blanket claim that all AutoEval results are invalid.
control_video_review.next_architecture_implication: Potential conditioning/write instability deserves attention if reproduced in normal revised-data outputs; wrong-condition failure alone does not identify its source or justify an untested numerical patch. Keep submitted new R11A unchanged until its own results.

official_protocol_check.result: No evidence of a first-frame-only read, wrong frame-count setting, or score parsing error for these two outputs. This does not audit all evaluator internals.

empty_control_video_review.scope: Two cases selected after completed fixed16 scores: largest PC increase under empty reasoning and only Joint loss. Eight sampled frames per arm, not a full-suite temporal or quality estimate.
empty_control_video_review.intervention: Only positive reasoning text emptied; own first image/request, native T5 and own negative C retained by frozen infer.py. This is not removal of all text conditioning.

cases.normal: 正常条件的气球向上离开画面，后半段出现占据画面的巨大透明曲面，没有清楚展示连续充气过程。
cases.empty: 空reasoning时气球保持近似大小，只见轻微飘动，画面较稳定，但没有清楚展示请求中的持续充气扩张。
cases.interpretation: PC从3到5包含明显的稳定性改善，却不能直接解释为完成充气物理过程；SA仍为3。该例贡献空条件PC净增加4分中的2分。

cases.normal: 正常条件下拖把位置与湿润区域变化较明显，但拖把头仍有形变，采样帧不足以证明准确的去水过程。
cases.empty: 空reasoning时前半段变化较弱，后段拖把头逐渐拉宽并出现重影式多片形态；未建立清楚完整的拖地去水过程。
cases.interpretation: 正常reasoning在此保留了更强的请求响应，也是16例中唯一额外Joint通过。不能据空条件较高PC均分判断应全面删除reasoning。

empty_control_video_review.decision: 保留正常与所有控制组的原始分数。旧失败版reasoning的PC净收益不成立，但个别请求执行受益；下一版要同时保留稳定性与过程执行，不能把接近静止的高PC当作完整成功。当前已提交新版保持冻结，待其同数据40/60/16结果再定位。

mean_control_video_review.scope: Two post-score selected cases: all new Joint passes under global training-mean C. Eight sampled frames per arm; no whole-suite visual estimate.

cases.normal: 正常条件的气球上移离开画面，后半段出现巨大透明曲面，充气过程不清楚。
cases.mean: 均值C视频保持稳定、气球大小变化很弱；与空reasoning相似，采样帧没有清楚展示充气扩张。
cases.interpretation: 这个新Joint通过不能直接视为完整执行了请求。该例PC增加2分，超过16例净增加的1分，其余15例PC总分反而少1；仍保留全部原始分数。

cases.normal: 正常条件出现明显周期纹理，滚筒逐渐收窄消失，未形成清楚的涂刷过程。
cases.mean: 均值C条件显著减少周期纹理，滚筒移动并留下可见的深绿色涂刷带，语义响应有实际改善；但中段滚筒与左侧杆的连接中断，后段出现不同朝向的支架，仍有接触/连接问题。
cases.interpretation: 这例确有画面和请求响应改善，不应把均值C优势全部解释为静止或评分失真；但还不能称为无缺陷的物理执行。

mean_control_video_review.decision: 旧版逐样本C的净贡献仍未成立。均值替换同时改变内容、幅度及正负条件差，不能把差异全部归因于语义信息；也不能据两例把所有均值收益否定为静止。下一版需让原请求绑定的物理作用在保留画面稳定性的同时改善动作/关系，当前新架构仍等待自身配对结果。

protocol: Same original40 plus historical20/combined60 I2V, nativeCFG5/physicalgamma5, seed42; not599/PhysVid T2V.
uncertainty: Paired bootstrap intervals resample prompts at one seed/evaluator; they do not show cross-seed reproducibility.
attribution: Normal-minus-control signs indicate this checkpoint response. Text-adapter/parallel interventions are not independently retrained architectures.
